SELECT ha.attribute_value, COUNT(*) AS score_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) AS heroes,
       COUNT(NULLIF(h.weight_kg, 0)) AS measured_heroes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN h.superhero_name = 'Abomination' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abomination_rows
FROM main.superhero AS h
JOIN main.hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = h.id
JOIN main.attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
GROUP BY ha.attribute_value
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN h.superhero_name = 'Abomination' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

arguments.sql:
WITH intelligence AS (
    SELECT h.superhero_name, h.weight_kg, ha.attribute_value AS score
    FROM main.superhero AS h
    JOIN main.hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = h.id
    JOIN main.attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
    WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(weight_kg, 0)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM intelligence
WHERE score = (
    SELECT score
    FROM intelligence
    WHERE superhero_name = 'Abomination'
)
LIMIT 1
